title: Learn RESTCONF basics before touching a live lab
scenario: A student team has not used YANG, NETCONF, or RESTCONF before. They need guided, step-by-step practice and explanations before selecting an execution environment.

title: Quickly inspect a shared API without configuration changes
scenario: A developer needs immediate read-only access to explore API responses from a Cisco platform. The work does not require administrative privileges, topology changes, VPN setup, or private isolation.

title: Test configuration automation in an isolated lab
scenario: A network automation script will change device configuration and must be tested in a private environment where the team can use administrative access. Setup time and VPN access are acceptable.

title: Find an existing automation example
scenario: A developer needs a working sample repository or reusable script pattern before writing a new automation tool. The main need is existing code to review and adapt.
